text:
maya-partners: Partner (PillarTech) ready to start marketplace listing. They asked what exactly goes into the "attestation bundle" for firmware-heavy devices. Can we align on minimal artifacts and upload steps?

frank-security: Minimal artifacts: SOC2 summary link, redacted pen-test PDF (no customer/PII), SBOM (CycloneDX), detached firmware signatures + RFC3161 timestamp token, signer cert chain (PEM), and a signed chain-of-custody statement. Also include KMS/HSM identifier or timestamping service receipt.

dina-eng: Packaging suggestion: one tar.gz per release: pillartech/<version>/attest.tar.gz. At repo root include manifest.json (sha256 map) and README.md describing redaction and contact.

sam-hw: PillarTech here we can provide detached .sig files and RFC3161 timestamps from TimeStampX. We have an HSM attestation report but it's large; can we include a reference instead of the full file?

frank-security: Reference is ok if the reference is a signed URL or a short signed statement with hash. For audits we prefer the full witness log, but we can accept a reference if it includes proof-of-hash and where to retrieve.

leo-ps: Upload flow: partner requests presigned multipart upload to s3://redwood-marketplace-ingest/pillartech/<version>/attest.tar.gz. Default presign TTL is 86400s. For >24h or >10GB we require ops approval. After upload partner posts manifest hash and ETag for verification. Security will do redaction review and sign-off.

ops-bot: Partner bucket policy: s3://redwood-marketplace-ingest/  presign max TTL 86400s  multipart supported. Tag uploads >10GB with "presign-extend" and file ops request. Audit logging enabled.

sam-hw: We'll likely be ~3GB. 24h fine. Can you share manifest template?

dina-eng: Template uploaded: https://drive.redwood/pillartech-manifest.json (fields: vendor, version, release_timestamp, files {name:sha256}, signer_cert_chain_pem, signature_files, sbom_filename, soc2_summary_url, pentest_redacted_filename, chain_of_custody_filename, hsm_attestation_ref, contact_email, redaction_approver).

frank-security: Redaction rules: remove customer names, internal IPs/hostnames, and PII. Keep CVEs, CVSS, vuln IDs, and remediation notes. Redaction approver must initial the manifest "redaction_approved_by" field before upload.

maya-partners: Action items: - Sam/PillarTech: assemble attest.tar.gz + manifest (owner: sam-hw) - Dina: confirm presign/multipart instructions & sample commands (owner: dina-eng) - Frank: publish redaction checklist + reserve review slot (owner: frank-security) - Leo: put manifest template + ingest prefix in drive (owner: leo-ps)

sam-hw: Starting today. ETA upload request by 1718830000. We'll request multipart presigns when ready.

frank-security: I'll block 30m on Friday for redaction review. Please tag me once uploaded.

maya-partners: Thanks all. I'll follow up if ops approval is needed. :thumbsup:
